title: Resistance Trace Heating in Potentially Explosive Atmospheres, Part 1: General and Testing Requirements
clause_1_scope: This standard ( Part 1 ) specifies requirements and test methods for electrical resistance heaters for application in potentially explosive atmospheres. The standard covers trace heaters that may either be factory or field (work site) assembled units, and which may be series heating cables, parallel heating cables, heating pads Tand heating panels that have been assembled and/or terminated in accordance with manufacturer's instructions. This standard also includes requirements for termination assemblies and control method used with trace heating. Requirements are given for potentially explosive areas, as defined in IS 5571.
